sources.label: Wikipedia, "Stella Ludoviciana"
sources.quote: Stella Ludoviciana, also known as HD 116798, is an 8th-magnitude star in the asterism of the Big Dipper in the constellation Ursa Major, halfway between Mizar and Alcor.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.6 solar radii and 1.52 solar masses (FLAME) and 7,223 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
